product.title: DopaBoost™ - 60 capsules
product.body_html:
DopaBoost™ is designed to support the body’s natural production of dopamine, a neurotransmitter essential for
the normal functioning of the central nervous system.* Dopamine is associated with attention, learning, movement,
balance, and mood regulation. It is frequently referred to as part of the brain’s “reward” system, as it can help
promote a positive outlook, motivation, and balanced moods.
Dopamine exerts many of its effects in the central nervous system, but it does not cross the blood-brain barrier.
Therefore, the way to raise dopamine levels in the brain is to provide precursor nutrients and other supportive
compounds that do cross into the brain, where dopamine can then be synthesized from them.
The primary ingredient in DopaBoost™ is Mucuna pruriens, a botanical compound that naturally contains
L-DOPA, a precursor to dopamine which can cross the blood-brain barrier.* Additional ingredients include EGCg
(epigallocatechin-3-gallate), acetyl L-tyrosine, quercetin and vitamin B6, all selected for their synergistic roles in the
production and regulation of dopamine.*
Key Ingredients
• Mucuna pruriens – A tropical plant that is a natural
source of L-DOPA, the metabolic precursor to
dopamine. The Mucuna material in DopaBoost™ is
standardized to contain an extremely potent
60% L-DOPA.*
• EGCg (from green tea extract) – An antioxidant with
brain-protective properties. The polyphenols in green
tea offer neuroprotective effects and help to increase
the availability of dopamine.*
• Quercetin – A flavonoid present in many fruits and
vegetables – it’s responsible for the bold pigments in red
apples, red onions, grapes and dark berries. Quercetin
naturally inhibits the activities of two enzymes—COMT
(catechol-o-methyl transferase) and MAO (monoamine
oxidase)—which are involved in the metabolism and
breakdown of dopamine. Quercetin works synergistically
with Mucuna pruriens and EGCg to help preserve
dopamine levels.*
• N-Acetyl-L-Tyrosine – Tyrosine is the amino acid from which dopamine is synthesized. (Neurotransmitters,
such as dopamine, serotonin and epinephrine, are made from amino acid
building blocks.)*
• Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate (P5P) – Vitamin B6 in its metabolically active form. P5P is an essential cofactor
for the enzyme that converts L-DOPA to dopamine, as well as converting 5-HTP to serotonin, another
“feel good” neurotransmitter that helps with a positive mental outlook. Other roles for P5P include healthy
metabolism of proteins, proper hormone signaling, and synthesis of heme, the portion of hemoglobin that
carries oxygen in the blood. For these reasons, adequate B6 levels may help maintain steady energy levels.*

product.title: Liposomal Glutathione - 50 mL liposomal
product.body_html: Liposomal Glutathione provides 100 mg of reduced glutathione in each serving. This product is formulated using liposomal technology, which results in superior delivery, absorption, and bioavailability. Liposomal delivery bypasses proteolytic degradation in the gastrointestinal (GI) tract and is uniquely effective for reaching and interacting with target tissues. Thus, this technology helps to overcome the absorption challenges typically faced with oral glutathione supplementation. Glutathione is one of the most powerful antioxidants produced by the body. It helps protect cells against oxidative stress from dietary and environmental free radicals, and those resulting from normal metabolic processes. Glutathione protects vulnerable DNA from damage, while also serving as a key factor in proper detoxification. Liposomal Glutathione is offered in a lemon-peppermint–flavoured formulation.

product.title: DHEA 50 mg - 60 tablets
product.body_html:
Dehydroepiandosterone (DHEA) is an endogenous substance that is made from cholesterol in the adrenal glands, sexual organs, and brain. It is a precursor to the male and female sex hormones. As we age, the body's production of DHEA decreases. The DHEA used here is derived from the wild yam root, a tropical tuber used since ancient times in the countries of South America and Africa.

The DHEA used here has been micronized to a particle size of less than 50 micrometers. The tablets have a special lipid matrix to protect the tiny DHEA crystals and promote their absorption.

It is recommended to measure the body's hormone levels before taking DHEA supplements and to monitor them regularly during the period of use. Competitive athletes are advised not to take products containing DHEA.

product.title: 5-HTP Synergy™ - 90 capsules
product.body_html:
5-HTP Synergy™ combines 5-hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP) and
pyridoxal-5-phosphate (the activated form of vitamin B6) to
help support healthy serotonin levels and general
neurotransmitter function. This synergistic formula is designed
to help the body maintain healthy sleep patterns, balanced
moods, and a normalized appetite. 5-HTP readily enters the
blood brain barrier and combines with vitamin B6 during
its conversion to serotonin. Therefore, 5-HTP Synergy™ is
the perfect blend for optimizing serotonin production and
neurotransmitter function.*
Why is Serotonin Important?
Serotonin is one of the most abundant neurotransmitters in
the brain and is often referred to as the “feel good hormone”
because of its role in sleep, mood, mental outlook, appetite,
body temperature, sexual behavior, and the body’s natural pain
response. Today’s hectic, stressful lifestyles can contribute to a
reduction in serotonin levels, which may affect these factors.
Serotonin, itself, does not cross the blood brain barrier; it is synthesized in the brain from its individual
components. Therefore, supplementing directly with serotonin would be ineffective for raising levels
in the brain, but providing its precursors, such as 5-HTP and vitamin B6, can help maintain healthy
serotonin levels.
Additional Highlights*
• 5-HTP may support healthy weight management, as it helps to balance appetite and minimize
cravings for carbohydrates.
• 5-HTP may be beneficial for aiding individuals in maintaining a low-glycemic or low-carbohydrate diet
by supporting balanced blood sugar levels.
• 5-HTP is highly absorbable and unaffected by the presence of other amino acids, meaning it can be
taken conveniently with food, without impacting its effectiveness.
• 5-HTP is also used by the body to produce other neurotransmitters and brain chemicals such
as melatonin, dopamine, norepinephrine, and beta-endorphin, comprehensively supporting
neurotransmitter function, mental health, and a positive mental outlook.
Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, take one capsule per day, or as directed by your health
care practitioner.

product.title: MegaGuard - 60 Capsules
product.body_html:
GUTGARD® LICORICE FLAVONOIDS | 75 mg
Licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra) has a long history of use for treating digestive discomforts. In Ayurvedic and Traditional Chinese Medicine, licorice is well-known for its ability to protect the gastric mucosa and modulate everyday inflammation. One of the most commonly known active ingredients in licorice is a saponin called glycyrrhizin that has been used as an emulsifier and sweetener in the food industry. However, most supplements contain deglycyrrhizinated licorice (DGL) because large amounts of glycyrrhizin have been associated with serious adverse side effects like elevated blood pressure and lowered potassium levels. Gutgard® licorice flavonoids are entirely different from DGL with respect to chemistry, composition, manufacturing, and mechanisms of action. While a classical extract of DGL does not contain any significant quantity of flavonoids, Gutgard® is standardized to contain more than 10% total flavonoids and less than 0.5% glycyrrhizin to avoid undesirable effects. More than 50 flavonoids have been identified in Gutgard® which have been shown to have beneficial activity for digestive complaints. In fact, Gutgard® licorice flavonoids have been shown to protect the stomach lining and balance Helicobacter pylori levels much more effectively than regular DGL extracts. Gutgard® licorice can also relieve occasional indigestion, bloating, and stomach pain at 150 mg/day.

ARTICHOKE LEAF EXTRACT | 320 mg
Artichoke (Cynara scolymus) leaf extract (ALE) has also been used in traditional medicine as a digestive aid. The bitter compounds, particularly cynaropicrin, are responsible for the digestive benefits of artichoke. ALE has been shown to increase bile production, protect the liver, balance blood lipids, and act as an antispasmodic. In 2003, German researchers demonstrated that 640 mg/day of artichoke leaf extract significantly improved digestive symptoms like bloating and fullness as well as quality of life in 244 patients with functional dyspepsia. Though the study was conducted over 6 weeks, the majority of the treatment group saw relief of their digestive symptoms in the first week.

GINGER ROOT EXTRACT (20%) | 30 mg
Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) has been used as a digestive aid in Eastern medicine for generations. Studies have demonstrated that ginger accelerates gastric emptying and can relieve occasional bouts of nausea and vomiting. Gingerols and shogaols, the active polyphenolic compounds in ginger, appear to be responsible for such effects by weakly inhibiting cholinergic M3 and serotonergic 5-HT3 receptors, whose temporary dysfunction is responsible for nausea, vomiting, and hypomotility. Ginger extracts with a higher gingerol content (20-30% gingerols) are stronger and more effective at relieving digestive discomforts. In 2015, an Italian study of 126 patients found that the daily combination of 40 mg of ginger extracts (25-30% gingerols) with 200 mg of artichoke leaf extracts reduced the severity and frequency of common digestive symptoms like nausea, bloating, early satiety, and abdominal pain 17% more effectively than just artichoke leaf extract alone. While most ginger extracts only contain 5% gingerols, MegaGuard™ contains 60 mg of high potency ginger root extract (20% gingerols) for maximum strength.

product.title: MegaMucosa - 180 capsules
product.body_html:
MegaMucosa is the first complete mucosal support supplement of its kind, formulated to REBUILD a healthy mucosal barrier, SUPPORT microbial diversity, and ALLEVIATE barrier dysfunction, otherwise known as leaky gut.

The mucosal system is a very important part of the human immune system. Not many people think of mucus as being protective, but it is the main interface between the human body and the outside world. The mucosal system contains 150 times more surface area than the skin, which makes it one of the most important immune barriers. The health of the mucosa determines how the body interacts with antigens; therefore, the integrity of the intestinal mucosa can dictate overall immune function.

product.title: PyloGuard - 30 capsules
product.body_html:
PyloGuard™ is a dietary supplement designed to support the body’s natural processes for elimination. It contains patented Lactobacillus reuteri DSM17648, which can attract specific organisms in the intestine and support their removal via the digestive tract. This particular strain of L. reuteri maintains H. pylori levels already within the normal range and supports overall digestive health.

**Key Benefits:**
- Supports bacteria levels in the stomach
- Promotes the body’s process of elimination
- Supports the microbiome
- Maintains H. pylori levels already within the normal range

**Key Features:**
- Lactobacillus reuteri DSM17648 culture containing ≥ 1 x 10^11 inactivated cells/gram
- Produced in a low-temperature fermentation & drying process to avoid denaturing
- Stable under gastric conditions
- Doesn’t disturb the gut microbial balance
- Formulated in a free-flowing, spray-dried powder format
- Stable at room temperature
- Backed by in vitro and in vivo scientific research
- Safe for long-term daily use (QPS, MIC, GRAS)
- Produced and tested to exceed the most stringent EU quality standards (ISO)
- Free from GMO, lactose, and fructose

**What is Helicobacter Pylori?**
Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is a gram-negative, spiral-shaped bacterium native to the human gastrointestinal (GI) tract. It has an affinity for the acidic environment of the gastric mucosa. Estimates say that up to 50% of the world’s population carries H. pylori in their GI tracts. H. pylori is spread through direct contact with individuals or household pets through saliva, feces, or contaminated food or water.

Humanity’s relationship with H. pylori is ambiguous. H. pylori can have a commensal or symbiotic relationship with its human host.

H. pylori colonizes and multiplies in the duodenum and gastric mucosa, secreting urease, the enzyme that converts urea to ammonia. Alkaline ammonia buffers the naturally low pH of the stomach, providing the optimal environment for H. pylori to live.

product.title: Ester-C® & Flavonoids - 90 capsules
product.body_html: Ester-C® & flavonoids offers a blend of Ester-C® and flavonoid compounds to provide vitamin C support for healthy immune and cellular function as well as blood vessel integrity. Ester-C®, consisting primarily of calcium ascorbate, is a natural, nonacidic water-soluble form of vitamin C that is distinguished by its unique biological activity. In a double-blind, placebo-controlled, crossover trial, Ester-C supplementation resulted in significantly higher white blood cell vitamin C concentrations compared to standard ascorbic acid at 8 hours and remained elevated at 24 hours. The bioflavonoids quercetin and rutin are free radical scavengers that complement the roles of vitamin C. Quercetin helps maintain healthy mast cell function and moderate healthy leukotriene and prostaglandin metabolism. Preclinical data show that rutin supports blood vessel integrity and healthy cell function.

stomach. These probiotics can safely reach your intestines intact, where they become active and promote your gut, skin, and
overall health

product.title: Laktoferrin with Colostrum - 90 capsules
product.body_html: This specialized formulation combines bovine lactoferrin with ethically sourced, first-milking colostrum to provide a concentrated source of bioactive proteins. Lactoferrin is a multifunctional iron-binding glycoprotein naturally found in secretory fluids, playing a key role in systemic iron homeostasis and physiological immune support. The inclusion of bovine colostrum provides a rich matrix of naturally occurring immunoglobulins (IgG), lactoperoxidase, and growth factors. Processed at low temperatures to maintain the structural integrity and biological activity of these delicate proteins, this supplement offers a high-purity approach to supporting the body’s innate physiological defenses and mucosal health.

product.title: Coenzyme Q10 50 mg - 75 capsules

The vegetarian-friendly capsules ensure a clean delivery of this essential nutrient, derived through a natural fermentation process for optimal purity.

product.title: Acetyl-L-Carnitine 500mg - 100 capsules
product.body_html: This formulation features Acetyl-L-Carnitine (ALC), a highly bioavailable acetylated ester of the amino acid L-carnitine. Functioning as a critical metabolic precursor, ALC facilitates the transport of long-chain fatty acids into the mitochondrial matrix for beta-oxidation and energy production. Its unique molecular structure allows it to cross the blood-brain barrier effectively, providing an acetyl group for the synthesis of acetylcholine, a primary neurotransmitter. This pharmaceutical-grade supplement is designed to support cellular energy metabolism and maintain physiological neurological function through high-purity ingredient delivery.

product.title: GluDaZyme™ - 60 capsules
product.body_html: GluDaZyme™ is a comprehensive enzymatic complex designed to support the physiological digestion of macronutrients, with a specific focus on complex proteins. The formulation utilizes a proprietary blend of proteolytic enzymes featuring Dipeptidyl Peptidase IV (DPP-IV) activity. Biochemically, DPP-IV is capable of cleaving proline-rich peptide bonds, such as those found in gluten (gliadin) and casein proteins, facilitating their breakdown into smaller peptides and amino acids. This matrix is complemented by a broad spectrum of amylases, lactases, and lipases to support the hydrolysis of carbohydrates, lactose, and dietary fats within the gastrointestinal tract.

product.title: Biomaintenance™ Prebiotic + Fiber - 378 g powder
product.body_html: This advanced formulation features a diverse matrix of soluble fibers and prebiotics designed to support the intestinal microbiome. The core ingredient is Sunfiber® (Partially Hydrolyzed Guar Gum), a water-soluble galactomannan that regulates intestinal transit and provides a fermentation substrate for beneficial bacteria. It is combined with Inulin, VitaFiber™ (Isomaltooligosaccharides), and PreticX™ (Xylooligosaccharides). Physiologically, these compounds resist digestion in the upper gastrointestinal tract, reaching the colon where they stimulate the growth of Bifidobacteria and Lactobacilli and facilitate the production of Short-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs) like butyrate.

Physiologically, these compounds resist digestion in the upper gastrointestinal tract, reaching the colon where they stimulate the growth of Bifidobacteria and Lactobacilli and facilitate the production of Short-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs) like butyrate.

product.title: Organic Psyllium Husk Powder - 454 g
product.body_html:
This product provides pure, certified organic Psyllium Husk Powder derived from the outer coating of the Plantago ovata seed. Psyllium is a rich source of soluble fiber, which has high water-holding capacity. Physiologically, it acts as a bulk-forming agent. Upon hydration, it forms a gelatinous mucilage that increases faecal bulk and facilitates intestinal transit. This contributes to the maintenance of a healthy bowel function and supports normal digestion. The soluble fiber content also aids in maintaining normal blood cholesterol levels.
Certified organic by Oregon Tilth.

product.title: L-Methylfolate 15mg - 60 capsules
product.body_html: This high-potency formulation delivers 15 mg of L-Methylfolate (5-MTHF), the biologically active, methylated form of folate. Unlike synthetic folic acid, 5-MTHF is directly bioavailable and does not require enzymatic conversion by the MTHFR enzyme, allowing it to cross the blood-brain barrier efficiently. Folate plays a vital physiological role, contributing to normal psychological function, normal amino acid synthesis, and the normal metabolism of homocysteine. It also contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue and the normal function of the immune system.

product.title: Magnesium Citrate - 120 capsules
product.body_html: This supplement provides magnesium in the citrate form, an organic salt recognized for its high bioavailability and excellent intestinal uptake. Magnesium is an essential mineral that acts as a cofactor in more than 300 enzymatic reactions, including those responsible for protein synthesis and energy production. Physiologically, magnesium contributes to normal muscle function, electrolyte balance, and the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. It also plays a vital role in the normal functioning of the nervous system and psychological function. By supporting the reduction of tiredness and fatigue, this highly absorbable form is an ideal choice for maintaining daily mineral balance and metabolic efficiency.

product.title: Resveratrol with Piperine - 60 capsules
product.body_html: This formulation delivers 200 mg of Resveratrol, a naturally occurring polyphenolic stilbenoid often found in the skin of red grapes and Japanese Knotweed (Polygonum cuspidatum). Resveratrol is recognized for its biological activity and antioxidant properties, which contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress. To overcome the naturally low bioavailability of stilbenoids, this product is fortified with 20 mg of Piperine (derived from Black Pepper). Piperine physiologically enhances the absorption and bioavailability of resveratrol by inhibiting the glucuronidation process in the liver.

product.title: CoQ10 100mg - 60 capsules

The product is fortified with Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), which contributes to normal energy-yielding metabolism and the protection of cells from oxidative stress.

product.title: SAMe 200mg - 60 capsules
product.body_html: This formulation delivers 200 mg of S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine (SAMe), a naturally occurring compound found in every living cell. Biologically, SAMe serves as a critical methyl donor in numerous biochemical reactions, including the synthesis of neurotransmitters such as dopamine, serotonin, and norepinephrine. It also plays a key role in transmethylation reactions essential for the synthesis of phospholipids and the maintenance of cell membrane structure. To ensure stability and efficacy, this product utilizes a specialized form of SAMe stabilized with calcium and is delivered in acid-resistant capsules for targeted intestinal release.

product.title: NAC 600mg - 60 capsules
product.body_html: This supplement features N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine (NAC), the acetylated and stable derivative of the semi-essential amino acid L-cysteine. product.title: L-Theanine 200mg - 120 capsules
product.body_html: This formulation features Suntheanine®, a patented and clinically researched form of L-Theanine. L-Theanine is a unique amino acid naturally found in green tea (Camellia sinensis). Structurally similar to glutamate, it is capable of crossing the blood-brain barrier. It also plays a role in the modulation of neurotransmitters, without acting as a sedative. The product is fortified with Glycine to further support physiological function.

product.title: Phytotein™ vanilla - 510 g powder
product.body_html: Phytotein™ is a delicious, dairy-free, plant-based protein powder that promotes protein status and nutritional support in the body. It features an organic protein blend primarily composed of organic pea protein with additional protein from organic sunflower, pumpkin seed, sacha inchi, and rice sources. Phytotein™ provides 20 g of protein per 1-scoop serving. This formula is a true vegetarian- and vegan-friendly protein powder that is easily digestible and absorbed in the body and offers a variety of nutritional benefits. Phytotein™ is a pleasant-tasting protein alternative for individuals with allergies or sensitivities to difficult-to-digest proteins, such as egg, whey, casein, and soy, and for those with lactose intolerance. The high-quality pea protein in this formula is nongenetically modified with a neutral taste and a smooth texture, and it is a good source of the amino acid lysine.

product.title: L-5-MTHF - 60 capsules
product.body_html: This L-5-MTHF formula provides 5 mg (8,500 mcg DFE) of biologically active folate, which is essential for cell division and growth and for proper homocysteine metabolism.* This formula provides folate in the bioidentical, bioactive form, 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (L-5-MTHF). The “L” in L-5-MTHF signifies its all-natural [6S] isomer, which is the active circulating form of folate found in the body and one of the several forms found in food. In nature, it is found only as the [6S] isomer, which is why DFH uses L-5-MTHF (as Quatrefolic®), the natural isomer, rather than the mixed (or racemic) form. This innovative form of folate has demonstrated high bioavailability, solubilitiy, and long-lasting stability. Quatrefolic® L-5-MTHF is superior to folic acid for helping to maintain optimal serum folate.

product.title: Digestzymes™ - 60 capsules
product.body_html: Digestzymes™ is comprised of a proprietary blend of digestive enzymes along with betaine hydrochloride (HCl) to support the optimal digestion of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates. This product contains the special protease dipeptidyl peptidase IV (DPPIV), which aids in the breakdown of the peptides gluteomorphin (from gluten) and casomorphin (from casein). Digestzymes™ also includes the enzyme lactase, which helps break down the dairy sugar, lactose. The use of Digestzymes™ before meals may be helpful for patients who experience gas and bloating after eating, occasional constipation, or a feeling of fullness after eating only a small quantity of food.

product.title: DFH Complete Multi with Copper & Iron - 120 capsules
product.body_html: DFH Complete Multi™ with Copper and Iron is a full-spectrum multivitamin with Albion-chelated minerals for maximum absorption and bioavailability. This powerhouse multivitamin supplies supportive nutrients not normally found in regular multivitamins, such as delta- and gamma-tocotrienols, trimethylglycine (TMG), and fruit bioflavonoids. This formula is appropriate for teenagers, menstruating females, and those who avoid eating red meat.

product.title: Annatto-E® 150 - 60 softgels
product.body_html:
Annatto-E™ 150 is a unique tocopherol-free, tocotrienols-only product featuring tocotrienols sourced from the annatto tree. Annatto is the richest known source of tocotrienols, containing 100% tocotrienols (90% delta-isomers and 10% gamma-isomers), with no tocopherols.

Annatto-E™ 150 contains 150 mg per softgel of delta- and gamma-tocotrienols. Commercial vitamin E supplements are typically rich in tocopherols and low or absent in tocotrienols; however, tocotrienol fractions have unique beneficial effects across a variety of tissues that make them desirable for supporting many aspects of health.*

Research indicates that tocopherols — especially alpha-tocopherols — may interfere with key clinical effects of tocotrienols, so it may be best to take tocotrienols alone, without tocopherols.

product.title: Mixed Vegetables® - 180 Tablets
product.body_html:
What is Mixed Vegetables®?

Mixed Vegetables® contains leafy greens as well as root and cruciferous vegetables. It is a highly concentrated extract of phytonutrients and provides a balance of naturally occurring nutrients. All ingredients are grown in peak season and carefully prepared to preserve freshness and nutritional value.
Plant sterols

Plant sterols (phytosterols, phytosterols) are secondary plant ingredients. They are mainly found in high-fat parts of plants such as oils, nuts and seeds. Phytosterols have a chemical structure that is very similar to cholesterol and have been shown to lower blood cholesterol levels. High cholesterol is a risk factor for developing coronary artery disease.
Vegetable Supplement

This product from NaturesPlus offers an ideal way to supplement the diet with additional vegetables. Each tablet provides a mixture of 4 vegetables.

product.title: Acetyl L-Carnitine - 90 capsules
product.body_html:
Acetyl L-Carnitine (ALC) is a natural component of our
brain’s chemistry and promotes production of acetylcholine,
the most abundant neurotransmitter in the brain. The body
makes ALC in small amounts, but as we age, levels decline.
ALC is a form of L-carnitine, an amino acid derivative that
helps the body produce energy. However, slightly altering
the chemical structure of this nutrient (adding the “acetyl”
group), helps it work differently in the body to support both
brain health and energy production.*
Brain Health
Acetyl L-Carnitine is structurally similar to acetylcholine
and may help facilitate its production and maintenance
of optimal levels. Acetylcholine is involved in supporting
memory, focus, and learning. It also serves to regulate
activities of vital organs and blood vessels, as well as
communication between nerves and muscles. ALC can help
support the repair of cells in the brain and nervous system
that have been damaged by stress and poor diet.*
Energy Production
L-Carnitine, (not the ALC form) is required to help escort fats into the part of the cell where they
are burned and converted into energy (the mitochondria), thereby supporting energy production
and weight management. Acetyl L-Carnitine works differently. Because the unique “acetyl” molecule
allows this compound to work differently in the body, ALC may support energy production within
brain cells, aiding in mental clarity, focus, and stamina.
Healthy Moods
The neurotransmitter acetylcholine is important for a healthy, balanced mood. Acetyl L-carnitine not
only supports a healthy mood by encouraging normal acetylcholine levels, but also by supporting
energy production and delivery to brain cells. Energized brain cells communicate better with each
other and with the rest of the body, leading to a healthier mood.*
Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, take one capsule per day, or as directed by your health
care practitioner.

product.title: Quercetin Plus® - 60 Tablets
product.body_html:
Quercetin Plus®
Quercetin Plus® contains the bioflavonoid quercetin supplemented with vitamin C and bromelain.

What are bioflavonoids?
Bioflavonoids are a large group of bioactive substances that occur naturally in plants. Fruits, vegetables, herbs, nuts, and seeds are particularly good sources. In the plant itself, these substances are involved in many different important processes, such as growth, protection against UV radiation, and insect repellent. In addition, they are often responsible for the color, smell, and taste of the plants.

Quercetin Supplement
Quercetin Plus® from NaturesPlus is an ideal way to obtain additional bioflavonoids. Each pack contains 60/90 tablets.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Vitamin B12 Herbal Lozenges - 30 Lozenges
product.body_html:
What is vitamin B12? Vitamin B12 (or cobalamin) is one of the water-soluble vitamins and is part of the B vitamin complex, which consists of eight B vitamins. Vitamin B12 is significantly involved in various metabolic processes in the body, including the breakdown of fatty acids. Its central importance for the metabolism of the vitamin folic acid (folate) also makes it important for blood formation. Other examples include support for homocysteine metabolism, contribution to brain and nerve functions, involvement in memory function, and help in reducing fatigue as well as lethargy. It plays an important role in tissue growth and development, not to mention its positive influence on the immune system.

Vitamin B12 in our food Vitamin B12 is found exclusively in animal foods. Under a strict vegan diet, it is therefore easier to develop a vitamin B12 deficiency. In addition, a vitamin B12 deficiency only becomes noticeable after years. The food richest in vitamin B12 is liver. Other food sources include meat, fish, eggs, and dairy products. Vitamin B12 is only contained in plant-based foods if bacterial fermentation has occurred, but then only in very small quantities (bacterial fermentation/fermentation e.g. sauerkraut) that are not sufficient to cover the recommended intake.

Vitamin B12 Herbal Lozenges Vitamin B12 Herbal Lozenges from NaturesPlus contain extracts of dandelion, sarsaparilla, raspberries, and beetroot in addition to 1,000 mcg of the activated form methylcobalamin. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Orange Juice 500 mg Vitamin C - 90 Lozenges
product.body_html:
What is Orange Juice?
Orange Juice contains 500 mg of vitamin C in orange-flavored lozenges.
Vitamin C
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body.
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.
More information about the

product.title: Ultra Lipoic™ mini tabs - 60 Mini Tablets
product.body_html:
What is Ultra Lipoic™?
Ultra Lipoic is a formula that consists of R-Lipoic Acid and Alpha-Lipoic™ Acid. Alpha-lipoic acid comes in two different forms (isomers), the R and S forms. The R-shape is the most natural and effective form of the body. However, the S-form can increase the bioavailability of the R-form. Because of this, this supplement contains a mixture of both forms.
In addition, the product offers a patented probiotic complex, as well as a patented complex with MSM (methylsulfonylmethane), NAC (N-acetyl cysteine), turmeric (standardized curcumin), grape seed extract (from Vitis vinifera, standardized proanthocyanidins).

Alpha Lipoic Acid
Alpha-lipoic acid is a sulfur-containing fatty acid that occurs naturally in the mitochondria of all cells in our body. It can be formed in small quantities in our body from the amino acid cysteine and the fatty acid octanoic acid. Alpha-lipoic acid is also found in limited quantities in our food, especially in animal offal, as well as in vegetables and fruits.

Supplement with Alpha Lipoic Acid
Ultra Lipoic™ by NaturesPlus contains 60 mini tablets per pack.

product.title: ImmunActin® Zinc Lozenges - 60 lozenges
product.body_html:
What is zinc?
The essential trace element zinc is involved in many processes in the human organism as a component and activator of numerous enzymes. Thus, it helps in the build-up and breakdown of carbohydrates, fats and protein. It also plays a role in growth, the immune system, sexual development and fertility, as well as the sensation of taste and appetite. Zinc is also involved in the antioxidant protection system against free radicals and also supports the bones. It plays a role in mental exertion and activity, as well as in stressful situations. Since there are only limited zinc stores in the body and these can only be mobilized with difficulty in the event of an undersupply, a continuous supply through food is particularly important.

Zinc in our food
Animal products are the main suppliers of zinc. Good sources include beef, pork, poultry, seafood such as crab or lobster, eggs, milk and cheese. In general, zinc can be better absorbed from animal foods than from plant foods. When it comes to plant-based food sources of zinc, cereal products and nuts are in the foreground.

Zinc as a supplement
ImmunActin® Zinc Lozenges from NaturesPlus provides 10 mg of elemental zinc as zinc aspartate in combination with standardized extracts of echinacea, olive leaves and elderberries per lozenge. One package contains 60 cherry-flavored lozenges.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Acti-Zyme - 180 Capsules
product.body_html:
What is Acti-Zyme? Acti-Zyme offers a carefully formulated combination of digestive enzymes. It is specially formulated to help the body digest proteins, carbohydrates, and fats. It also contains FOS (fructooligosaccharides) and probiotics.

What are digestive enzymes? Digestive enzymes are proteins that are involved in breaking down nutrients into smaller building blocks in the body. There are many different digestive enzymes – each with a different function. Acti-Zyme contains amylase, lipase, and lactase, among others. Amylase is an enzyme that allows carbohydrates to break down into individual sugar molecules. Lipase helps the body break down fats, as well as lactase helps break down lactose (milk sugar).

Bioperine This product contains Bioperine from Piper nigrum, which can increase the bioavailability and effects of numerous substances.

Acti-Zyme Capsules NaturesPlus Acti-Zyme contains a comprehensive combination of digestive enzymes. This product contains 90/180 capsules per pack. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Vitamin D3 1000 IU tablets - 90 Lozenges
product.body_html:
Adult's Chewable Vitamin D3 1000 IU
are berry-flavored lozenges; an alternative for people who cannot swallow normal tablets or capsules.
Vitamin D is a vitamin that the body can produce on its own. Vitamin D synthesis takes place in the skin with the help of sunlight. That's why vitamin D is also known as the sunshine vitamin.
In the months when there is little sunshine, the amount of sunlight is too low for sufficient vitamin D production, so most people develop a deficiency. A dietary supplement with vitamin D is therefore a useful extra for many people, especially in winter.
Vitamin D helps reduce the risk of falling, which is associated with postural instability and muscle weakness. Falls are a risk factor for fractures in men and women over the age of 60.

product.title: Vitamin D3 400 IU - 90 Tablets
product.body_html:
Vitamin D3
contains 400 IU of cholecalciferol. Vitamin D is a vitamin that the body can produce on its own. Vitamin D synthesis takes place in the skin with the help of sunlight. That's why vitamin D is also known as the sunshine vitamin.
In the months when there is little sunshine, the amount of sunlight is too low for sufficient vitamin D production, so most people develop a deficiency. A dietary supplement with vitamin D is therefore a useful extra for many people, especially in winter.
Vitamin D helps reduce the risk of falling, which is associated with postural instability and muscle weakness. Falls are a risk factor for fractures in men and women over the age of 60.

product.title: Cal/Mag/Vit. D3 with Vitamin K2 - 60 Lozenges
product.body_html: Cal/Mag/Vit. D3/K2 contains the minerals calcium, magnesium and vitamins D3 and K2. Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the human body and performs a variety of tasks. These include the structure and strength of bones and teeth, the transmission of nerve impulses, muscle contraction, blood clotting and wound healing. Magnesium strengthens bones and teeth, relaxes muscles, is important for mental and cardiovascular health, has a positive effect on the cell division process and supports the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Vitamins D3 and K2 play a role in the formation of new bones and teeth. While vitamin D helps store calcium in the bones, vitamin K can help activate the bone protein osteocalcin. Every cell needs minerals for its structure and proper functioning. Minerals are of particular importance as electrolytes and as central atoms of enzymes. Together with vitamins, they are crucial building blocks for health. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Acti-Zyme - 90 Capsules
product.body_html:
What is Acti-Zyme? Acti-Zyme offers a carefully formulated combination of digestive enzymes. It is specially formulated to help the body digest proteins, carbohydrates, and fats. It also contains FOS (fructooligosaccharides) and probiotics.

What are digestive enzymes? Digestive enzymes are proteins that are involved in breaking down nutrients into smaller building blocks in the body. There are many different digestive enzymes – each with a different function. Acti-Zyme contains amylase, lipase, and lactase, among others. Amylase is an enzyme that allows carbohydrates to break down into individual sugar molecules. Lipase helps the body break down fats, as well as lactase helps break down lactose (milk sugar).

Bioperine This product contains Bioperine from Piper nigrum, which can increase the bioavailability and effects of numerous substances.

Acti-Zyme Capsules NaturesPlus Acti-Zyme contains a comprehensive combination of digestive enzymes. This product contains 90/180 capsules per pack. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: AgeLoss 1st Day Inflammation Support, 90 Tabl. - 90 Tablets
product.body_html:
What is AgeLoss® First Day?
AgeLoss® First Day has been specially developed to optimally support the immune system during the aging process. It contains a carefully selected combination of vitamins, minerals, bioactive substances, as well as plant extracts that, among other things, contribute to the normal functioning of the immune system and help the body protect itself from oxidative damage.
Support for the immune system
They want to be vital at every stage of life. Maintaining a good immune system plays an essential role in this. Vitamin A, vitamin C, zinc and selenium have a positive influence on the immune system and thus help to ensure a good immune system. In addition, these nutrients, along with vitamin E, act as antioxidants, helping to protect healthy cells and tissues from external aggressors.
Special Ingredients
AgeLoss® First Day offers a broad combination of bioactive substances and standardized plant extracts. It contains, among other things, turmeric, olive leaf extract and green tea, standardized to 95% polyphenols, of which 40% are EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate). In addition, an extensive blend of fruit extracts has been added, consisting of grape seed extract, blueberry and cranberry, among others.
AgeLoss® First Day Tablets
AgeLoss® First Day contains an extensive amount of vitamins, minerals, bioactive substances and plant extracts per tablet. This product provides 90 tablets per package. Natures Plus products are 100% natural - with quality guarantees from independent laboratories.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Beyond CoQ10™ 200 mg - 60 Softgels
product.body_html:
What is Ubiquinol?

Beyond CoQ10™ is a product with a high dose of ubiquinol, the reduced form of coenzyme Q10. A substance that occurs naturally in all cells. Our body can convert coenzyme Q10 into ubiquinol. However, by choosing a supplement with ubiquinol, this conversion step can be skipped.
Ubiquinol in our food
In addition to the body's own production of ubiquinol, we also receive small amounts from our food. Meat, fish, nuts and dark green vegetables are relatively good sources.
Ubiquinol Supplement
Natures Plus' Beyond CoQ10™ contains pure pharmaceutical-grade ubiquinol. This product provides 200 mg of ubiquinol per softgel. Each pack provides 30/60 softgels.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Chewable Bromelain 40 mg - 180 Lozenges
product.body_html:
Chewable Bromelain
is extracted from pineapple. It also contains papaya fruits with the enzyme papain. Bromelain is an enzyme that breaks down peptide bonds of denatured proteins.
Enzymes are complex protein molecules that are also known as biocatalysts. They are needed for digestive processes, energy production in the respiratory chain, the transmission of genetic information and the regulation of inflammatory and other metabolic processes in the cell.

product.title: Pantothenic Acid 1000 mg - 60 Tablets
product.body_html:
What is pantothenic acid? Pantothenic acid is a water-soluble vitamin and belongs to the group of B vitamins. Pantothenic acid plays a central role in energy metabolism. As a component of coenzyme A, it is required for the breakdown of fats, carbohydrates, and various amino acids, as well as for the formation of fatty acids, cholesterol and steroid hormones, vitamin D, and some neurotransmitters. Pantothenic acid provides support in stressful situations and busy times.

Pantothenic acid in the diet Pantothenic acid is found in meat, eggs, whole grains, legumes, milk and dairy products, corn, cauliflower, kale, broccoli, avocado, and peach.

Pantothenic acid as a tablet Pantothenic acid from NaturesPlus contains 60 tablets of 1,000 mg of delayed-release pantothenic acid each. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Egg Yolk Lecithin 600 mg - 180 Capsules
product.body_html: Lecithin are phospholipids. fat-like substances composed of fatty acids, glycerin, phosphoric acid and another building block such as choline or an amino acid. They are components of cell membranes and are essential for their function. Lecithins are involved in the formation and conversion as well as the distribution of lipids. As natural emulsifiers, they are able to interact with both water and oil at the same time. As a component of bile, they ensure that dietary fats can be absorbed. Lecithins can support the health of the cardiovascular, brain, liver, and intestines. Nature's Plus products are 100% natural. With quality guarantees from independent laboratories.

product.title: Immune Zinc Lozenge - 60 Lozenges
product.body_html:
What is zinc?
Zinc is an essential trace element. This means that the body cannot produce it itself and therefore has to absorb it through food. It plays a role in numerous bodily processes: zinc supports the immune system, is involved in cell division, and contributes to vision and normal fertility in men and women.

Copper
Zinc and copper work synergistically. For this reason, copper was added to the formula.

Immune Zinc Lozenges
NaturesPlus' Immune Zinc Lozenges contains 5.5 mg of zinc and 0.3 mg of copper in lozenges for effective absorption through the oral mucous membranes.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Source of Life® Vibra-Gest® - 180 Capsules
product.body_html:
Vibra-Gest
contains enzymes from fermented brown rice, barley malt, sweet potato, pineapple, papaya and carrot powder together with bacteria of the lactic acid flora.

What are enzymes?
Enzymes are complex protein molecules that are also known as biocatalysts. They are needed for digestive processes, energy production in the respiratory chain, the transmission of genetic information and the regulation of inflammatory and other metabolic processes in the cell.
Note: To promote digestion, enzymes are taken with meals, for regulatory support in inflammatory processes between meals.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Vitamin C Micro-Crystals - 227g Powder
product.body_html:
What are vitamin C microcrystals? Vitamin C Micro-Crystals contains 5,000 mg of pure crystalline vitamin C powder per teaspoon, without additives. It can be added to juice or sprinkled over food.

Vitamin C Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body. Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress, and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy. Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption, and contributes to normal collagen formation as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage, and skin.

Vitamin C in our diet Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food. Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries, and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: AgeLoss Hair Support, 90 Tabl. - 90 Tablets
product.body_html:
What is AgeLoss® Hair Support?
Too much sun, blow-drying, chemical treatments, and poor diet are stressors that can stress the hair and cause it to age faster. AgeLoss® Hair Support provides a combination of nutrients to support hair structure. The ingredients are in extended-release tablets that allow for a long-lasting release of the nutrients.

Strong and shiny
AgeLoss® Hair Support contains zinc and biotin (vitamin B7). These nutrients are known to contribute to normal hair growth and keep hair strong and shiny. In addition, this product provides the antioxidants vitamin C, riboflavin (vitamin B2), and folate (vitamin B9) to protect the healthy cells and tissues in the body from external influences, such as sunlight and air pollution.

Special Ingredients
AgeLoss® Hair Support is enriched with a special combination of bioactive substances and natural extracts. A bamboo extract provides 70% silicon (silica), a mineral that occurs naturally in high concentrations in connective tissue and also in the hair. It also contains an extensive blend of extracts from fruits and vegetables, such as berries, kiwi, citrus fruits, and green leafy vegetables. It also contains the sulphur donor MSM (methylsulfonylmethane), the amino acid L-cysteine, a turmeric extract, and apple polyphenols.

AgeLoss® Hair Support Tablets
AgeLoss® Hair Support by Natures Plus offers a carefully formulated combination of vitamins, minerals, and bioactive substances in extended-release tablets. Each pack provides 90 tablets. Natures Plus products are 100% natural - with quality guarantees from independent laboratories.

Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

Men's Ultra Hair® Plus is specially formulated to nourish the hair from the inside out. Your hair has to deal with stressors on a daily basis, such as the UV rays of sunlight and the heat of a hair dryer. product.title: Ultra-C 2000 mg - 60 Tablets
product.body_html:
What is Ultra-C 2000 mg?
Ultra-C contains 2,000 mg of vitamin C supplemented by 200 mg of rosehip to increase bioavailability per delayed-release tablet.
What is vitamin C?
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy. Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect in many different places and in the most diverse processes of our body:
It contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system, as well as the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation, as well as to the normal functioning of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.
Ultra-C 2000 mg as a tablet
Ultra-C 2000 mg of NaturesPlus contains 60 or 90 delayed-release tablets.

product.title: Super C Complex 500 mg - 90 Capsules
product.body_html:
What is Super C Complex 500 mg Caps?
Super C Complex capsules contains 500 mg of vitamin C supplemented by the bioflavonoids rutin and hesperdin to improve the absorption of vitamin C.

What is vitamin C?
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect in many different places and in the most diverse processes of our body:
It contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system, as well as the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation, as well as to the normal functioning of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.
Super C Complex 500 mg caps as capsules
Super C Complex 500 mg Caps by NaturesPlus contains 90 or 180 vegetarian capsules.

product.title: AgeLoss Joint Support - 90 Tablets
product.body_html:
What is AgeLoss® Joint Support?
AgeLoss® Joint Support is specifically designed to support the cartilage in the joints during the aging process. It contains a special combination of ingredients, including vitamin C, manganese, glucosamine, chondroitin, hyaluronic acid, and collagen.
To maintain healthy cartilage
AgeLoss® Joint Support provides a generous amount of vitamin C from organic gooseberries. This vitamin contributes to normal collagen formation and helps maintain healthy cartilage in the joints. AgeLoss® Joint Support also provides manganese, which supports the production of cartilage and bone tissue.
With glucosamine and chondroitin
Glucosamine and chondroitin are building blocks that occur naturally in the cartilage and synovial fluid of our body. The substances can be produced by the body itself or taken as dietary supplements. AgeLoss® Joint Support also contains hyaluronic acid and collagen. These are both substances that are part of the connective tissue in our body. The patented ingredient ApresFlex® also provides a
Boswellia serrata
extract, which is widely used in traditional Indian herbalism.
AgeLoss® Joint Support Tablets
AgeLoss® Joint Support by Natures Plus contains a carefully formulated combination of vitamin C, manganese, bioactive substances as well as plant extracts. This product provides 90 tablets per package. Natures Plus products are 100% natural - with quality guarantees from independent laboratories.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.body_html:
Multivitamin especially for women
AgeLoss® Women's Multi is a multivitamin specifically designed for women over 50. It contains a carefully formulated combination of vitamins, minerals and bioactive substances that meet the daily nutritional needs of women. Ideal for keeping the body vital and healthy.

Supplemental Vitamin D
By adding vitamin D3, vitamin K2 and calcium, AgeLoss® Women's Multi provides extra support for bones. The German Society for Nutrition advises women over 50 to take additional vitamin D to strengthen their bones. Vitamin B12 and magnesium support energy levels and help reduce energy deficiency. In addition, vitamin C and selenium contribute to a good immune system and zinc to the regulation of hormonal balance.
Special Ingredients
AgeLoss® Women's Multi offers a rich combination of bioactive substances and plant extracts specifically for women. It contains, among other things, soy isoflavones and cranberry extract. In addition, lignans from flaxseed and a
Rhodiola rosea
extract. In addition, it provides flavonoids and amino acids in their free form.

product.title: Stabilium® 200 - 30 softgels
product.body_html: Stabilium® 200 is a specially formulated dietary supplement. It contains Garum Armoricum® fish hydrolysate, vitamin B6, vitamin E and vitamin A. Garum Armoricum® is an extract from the fish Molva dypterygia, found in deep waters off the Armorican peninsula of Brittany. It was used by the ancient Celts of Armorica, Ireland, and by the ancient Romans, as a food supplement to improve resilience to physical and emotional stress. Research confirms that Stabilium® 200 may be useful for coping with stresses from work or personal life, and can support healthy sleep patterns, energy, memory, and mood.

product.title: Sano-Gastril® Digest’ - 36 chewables
product.body_html:
Many factors can impact our digestive well-being: unbalanced diet, medication use, stress, bad eating habits, etc. Sano-Gastril® Digest' is a unique food supplement obtained by fermentation of soybeans (Glycine maximus L.) by a special strain of lactobacillus: Lactobacillus bulgaricus Lb 51. The scientific history of this ingredient begins in the 1960s with the work of Dr. Ivan Bogdanov. It is now supported by solid scientific and clinical evidence from over 600 people tested in total. Fennel (Foeniculum vulgare Mil.) is used to aid digestion and to help reduce digestive discomforts such as bloating.

Sano-Gastril® Digest' is suitable for people prone to discomfort caused by certain eating habits, overly acidic food, meals eaten too quickly, excess alcohol, coffee or overly spicy dishes.

product.title: Iodoral® 50 mg - 30 tablets
product.body_html: Iodine is one of the essential trace elements that our body cannot produce on its own. It is a component of the thyroid hormone thyroxine and is therefore of central importance for the functioning of the metabolism. All human organ systems (especially the nervous system) depend on iodine. Iodine is also important for maintaining body temperature (basal metabolism) and for cell division and growth. In addition, it plays a role in maintaining normal skin (regenerative ability), contributes to normal cognitive function and thus plays an important role in mental movement and activity. It supports normal growth in children. An undersupply of iodine can become noticeable through an enlargement of the thyroid gland as a goiter (goiter). The formulation of the product Iodoral is based on Lugol's solution. Each tablet contains a mixture of iodine (20 mg) and potassium iodide (30 mg).

product.title: ImmunoMod-A™ - 120 capsules
product.body_html: ImmunoMod-A™ has been formulated to help balance a healthy inflammatory response, which is necessary to help maintain optimal immune function in the body. It features ParActin®, an extract of the herb Andrographis paniculata, which has been shown to help modulate immune, inflammatory, and oxidative pathways. This product also contains the monosaccharide N-acetyl-D-glucosamine, along with curcumin, a polyphenolic compound extract from the spice turmeric. product.title: Magnesium Malate - 240 capsules
product.body_html:
Magnesium is an essential mineral that serves as an enzyme cofactor for over three hundred biochemical
reactions in the body. The need for magnesium throughout the body is reflected in the fact that the adult
human body contains approximately 25 grams of magnesium, divided among the skeleton, muscle tissue,
blood, and other areas.
Magnesium malate is a form of magnesium bound to malic acid, which is a compound found naturally
in fruits and vegetables, and is responsible for the tart flavor of rhubarb and green apples. Magnesium is a
required cofactor for enzymes that harness energy from carbohydrates, while malic acid is an intermediary of
the complex process that generates energy from all fuel sources, including carbohydrates, fats, and ketones.
Therefore, magnesium malate may be especially beneficial for individuals who experience occasional low
energy and fatigue.
Magnesium may also support:
• Cardiovascular function: Owing to its role in muscle contraction and relaxation, and nerve conduction,
magnesium may help support healthy blood pressure levels and cardiovascular function.
• Healthy carbohydrate tolerance: Magnesium is indispensable for converting carbohydrate (glucose) to
energy, and is also required for proper functioning of the insulin receptor. Individuals who experience
occasional issues related to blood glucose levels and carbohydrate tolerance may benefit from
supplemental magnesium.
• Bone health: Sixty percent of the magnesium in the human body is found in the skeleton. Magnesium
is an essential element of the physical structure of bone tissue. Supplementing with calcium alone often
does not have the desired effect of strengthening bones; maintenance of healthy bones requires adequate
magnesium, along with protein and other mineral cofactors.
Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, take two capsules per day with meals, or as directed by your
health care practitioner.

product.title: Protein Shake Gold Vanilla - 468 g powder
product.body_html: Protein is the most important structural element of all body cells, especially muscle cells. Through the digestive process, dietary proteins are broken down into individual amino acids, which are then used to form nucleic acids, enzymes, hormones, neurotransmitters, and blood cells, as well as cell repair, nervous and immune systems. Animal protein comes mainly from meat, eggs or milk, while vegetable protein comes from rice, soy or legumes such as peas. Animal protein usually provides a higher quality profile of amino acids. However, this difference can be compensated for by combining selected plant-based proteins. product.title: Iron - 90 tablets
product.body_html:
What is iron? Iron is one of the essential trace elements that our body cannot produce on its own. It is involved in many processes in the human organism, including the transport of oxygen as a component of the red blood pigment haemoglobin and the storage of oxygen in the muscles. In addition, iron is necessary for blood formation as well as for the functioning of various enzymes and many metabolic processes. It helps to release energy from fat, carbohydrates, and protein, reduces energy deficiency, and also contributes to normal cell division. Children need iron for brain development. An undersupply of iron can occur, among other things, due to blood loss (menstruation) or phases of increased demand, e.g. pregnancy, children in the growth phase.

Iron in our food Iron is particularly found in animal products such as meat and fish. Animal foods contain divalent iron, which can be better utilized by the body than plant-based, trivalent iron. Nevertheless, plant-based foods such as legumes, whole grains, spinach, peas, and salsify also contribute to meeting iron requirements. Vitamin C can promote the absorption of iron. It is therefore recommended to consume foods rich in vitamin C such as orange juice, peppers, or broccoli at the same time.

Iron as a supplement NaturesPlus' Iron contains 20 mg of bioavailable iron per tablet. One pack provides 90 tablets or 180 tablets. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: PharmaGABA® - 60 chewables
product.body_html: PharmaGABA® is naturally sourced, bioidentical gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA). It is made by a process in which the amino acid of glutamic acid (glutamate) is fermented using Lactobacillus hilgardii, the beneficial bacteria that is also used to ferment many foods including the vegetables in kimchi, the famous Korean dish. PharmaGABA® provides 200 mg of GABA per serving (2 tablets). The chewable tablet delivery allows for rapid and efficient absorption and assimilation. GABA is a naturally occurring amino acid in the brain, and it is a major inhibitory neurotransmitter in the central nervous system. GABA serves as a critical calming agent for the body, helping to combat occasional stress and anxiety.

product.title: Sensitol™ - 120 capsules
product.body_html:
Sensitol™ is a unique formulation comprised of two naturally occurring forms of the nutrient inositol—
myo-inositol (MI) and D-chiro-inositol (DCI)—along with alpha lipoic acid. It is designed to support
healthy insulin signaling, cellular metabolism and female hormone balance.*
Once considered a member of the B vitamin family, inositol was deemed “non-essential” when it was
discovered that the human body can make inositol from glucose. However, as is the case for many other
nutrients, there are certain situations that may benefit from supplementing with inositol at levels above
that which the body typically produces.
Inositol occurs naturally in a variety of foods—fruit, in
particular—but due to being bound to other compounds, it
is not as bioavailable in other foods that would otherwise
be good sources, such as grains and beans. Inositol occurs
naturally in nine different forms (called isomers). The MI
and DCI isomers have been recognized to be the most
predominant and have important functions in human
physiology, such as mediating normal cell signaling
from insulin and from other hormones, such as thyroid
hormones and sex hormones (for example, estrogen).
Several aspects of our modern diets and lifestyles
contribute to elevated insulin levels in susceptible individuals. And while insulin is best known for its
role in lowering blood sugar after meals (particularly ones containing carbohydrate), that is only one of
many functions insulin performs. Insulin is an essential hormone with a multitude of crucial roles, but it’s
possible to get “too much of a good thing.” The key is finding, and maintaining, the proper balance.
The forms of inositol in Sensitol™ may help the body respond better to insulin, thus having a beneficial
effect on metabolic and hormonal processes that are influenced by healthy insulin signaling.* Inositol is
also an important factor for balancing female hormones by supporting healthy liver function.* The liver is
a key organ in the detoxification and clearance of excess hormones, such as estrogen and testosterone,
so proper support for these pathways may facilitate healthy hormone levels.*
This product also contains alpha-lipoic acid, a compound that influences sensitivity to insulin,
contributes to healthy blood sugar levels, and supports the conversion of glucose (primarily from
carbohydrate) into energy.*
Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, take two capsules two times per day, or as directed by
your health care practitioner.

product.title: Vessel Forte™ - 120 capsules
product.body_html:
Vessel Forte™ is a synergistic combination of natural extracts that have been extensively researched for their benefits in supporting the strength, elasticity, and health of blood vessels, and optimizing blood circulation. Many Americans struggle with poor circulation and compromised vessel health. Contributing factors include pregnancy, obesity (additional weight adds increased pressure on the body), hormonal changes, menopause, poor diet, lack of exercise, and prolonged sitting or standing. Vessel Forte™ also assists in ensuring healthy blood and lymph circulation by providing antioxidants, which protect vessels from damaging free radicals. It also aids the body in mounting a normal inflammatory response that will not damage vessels or circulatory health.

Highlights of Vessel Forte™:
Sweet Orange Extract (Citrus sinensis) – a naturally occurring compound from citrus rinds, which is rich in bioflavonoids and acts as a vessel-protecting agent. It supports a healthy inflammatory response when vessels are under pressure and preserves healthy vessel tone.
Horse Chestnut Extract – contains a unique compound that protects the structural integrity of the smallest blood vessels, known as capillaries. These vessels are only one cell layer thick and are involved in the critical exchange of oxygen and nutrients between blood and body tissues.
Vitamin C – an important nutrient in collagen production and vessel integrity. Collagen is one of the key structural proteins in blood vessels and other connective tissues; it helps to maintain vessel strength and elasticity.
Grape Seed Extract – a source of potent antioxidants that help improve blood circulation by strengthening capillaries, arteries, and veins. Its ability to bond with collagen suggests that grape seed extract is beneficial in promoting skin health, cell health, elasticity, and flexibility.
Gotu Kola (Centella asiatica) – promotes collagen synthesis and helps support vessel wall strength and elasticity. It also helps to maintain healthy circulation by strengthening the integrity of capillary walls so excess fluid does not leak into surrounding tissues and cause occasional swelling.
Quercetin – a flavonoid antioxidant found abundantly in red onion, capers, and leafy green culinary herbs that supports the maintenance of healthy blood vessels and normal blood viscosity (thickness).

Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, take four capsules per day, or as directed by your health care practitioner.

Grape Seed Extract – a source of potent antioxidants that help improve blood circulation by strengthening capillaries, arteries, and veins. Its ability to bond with collagen suggests that grape seed extract is beneficial in promoting skin health, cell health, elasticity, and flexibility.
Gotu Kola (Centella asiatica) – promotes collagen synthesis and helps support vessel wall strength and elasticity. It also helps to maintain healthy circulation by strengthening the integrity of capillary walls so excess fluid does not leak into surrounding tissues and cause occasional swelling.
Quercetin – a flavonoid antioxidant found abundantly in red onion, capers, and leafy green culinary herbs that supports the maintenance of healthy blood vessels and normal blood viscosity (thickness).

Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, take four capsules per day, or as directed by your health care practitioner.

product.title: PaleoFiber® RS - 300 g powder
product.body_html: PaleoFiber® RS contains two forms of resistant starch (RS) type II: organic green banana flour and organic potato starch powder. RS is a type of starch that is resistant to digestion, as enzymes in the gastrointestinal (GI) tract are inactive against it. Once RS reaches the large intestine, it is fermented into short-chain fatty acids, which are used as fuel for both beneficial microbes and enterocytes of the GI tract. PaleoFiber® RS benefits GI health through its ability to support microbial balance and proper intestinal permeability and integrity. Additionally, this formula may help support optimal blood sugar and insulin metabolism, normal appetite, and cardiovascular health.

product.title: GPC Liquid - 59 mL liquid
product.body_html:
Glycerophosphocholine (GPC) is a source of choline, which is a building block for critical compounds
in the body—in particular, acetylcholine and phosphatidylcholine. Acetylcholine is a neurotransmitter
that plays crucial roles in memory, learning, muscle coordination and movement, and both aspects of
the nervous system: the sympathetic nervous system (“fight or flight”) and parasympathetic nervous
system (“rest and digest”). Phosphatidylcholine is an essential component of all cell membranes,
including neurons in the brain as well as the myelin coating that surrounds and protects neurons.
Choline is also a major constituent of lung surfactant, a naturally produced compound needed for
healthy lung function.
Choline is required for the healthy metabolism of fats, especially with regard to the role of the liver
in processing fats and making the proper components (called lipoprotein particles) that transport
cholesterol and fat-soluble nutrients throughout the bloodstream. A healthy supply of choline allows
fats to be processed properly as opposed to accumulating in the liver.
The human body synthesizes choline internally, but this production is relatively limited and may not
always be adequate to meet an individual’s needs, particularly if they may have an increased demand
for choline, such as if requiring support for memory and cognition, neurological function, balanced
moods, and supporting overall physical and mental vitality during aging. For these reasons, choline is
considered an essential nutrient. Choline is found in egg yolks, liver, beef, peanuts, broccoli, cauliflower
and other foods of both animal and vegetable origin, but supplemental amounts, as provided by GPC,
may be warranted for some individuals. Animal foods tend to be more concentrated sources of choline

and other neurotransmitters, GPC may help support brain structure and function and nervous system
function.* The chemical structure of GPC makes it more effective for supporting the body’s levels of
choline than choline or phosphatidylcholine from foods.

product.description:
Glycerophosphocholine (GPC) is a source of choline, which is a building block for critical compounds
in the body—in particular, acetylcholine and phosphatidylcholine. Acetylcholine is a neurotransmitter
that plays crucial roles in memory, learning, muscle coordination and movement, and both aspects of
the nervous system: the sympathetic nervous system (“fight or flight”) and parasympathetic nervous
system (“rest and digest”). Phosphatidylcholine is an essential component of all cell membranes,
including neurons in the brain as well as the myelin coating that surrounds and protects neurons.
Choline is also a major constituent of lung surfactant, a naturally produced compound needed for
healthy lung function.
Choline is required for the healthy metabolism of fats, especially with regard to the role of the liver
in processing fats and making the proper components (called lipoprotein particles) that transport
cholesterol and fat-soluble nutrients throughout the bloodstream. A healthy supply of choline allows
fats to be processed properly as opposed to accumulating in the liver.
The human body synthesizes choline internally, but this production is relatively limited and may not
always be adequate to meet an individual’s needs, particularly if they may have an increased demand
for choline, such as if requiring support for memory and cognition, neurological function, balanced
moods, and supporting overall physical and mental vitality during aging. For these reasons, choline is
considered an essential nutrient. Choline is found in egg yolks, liver, beef, peanuts, broccoli, cauliflower
and other foods of both animal and vegetable origin, but supplemental amounts, as provided by GPC,
may be warranted for some individuals. Animal foods tend to be more concentrated sources of choline
than plant foods, and heavy alcohol consumption increases the need for choline.
Owing to the role of choline in neuron structure and function, as well as in synthesis of acetylcholine
and other neurotransmitters, GPC may help support brain structure and function and nervous system
function.* The chemical structure of GPC makes it more effective for supporting the body’s levels of
choline than choline or phosphatidylcholine from foods.
Our GPC is available in liquid and capsule form. GPC has a naturally delicious, sweet taste on its own, so
no additional sweeteners are used in the liquid form.
Recommended Use
GPC Capsules: As a dietary supplement, take one capsule per day, or as directed by your health
care practitioner.
GPC Liquid: As a dietary supplement, take 2 mL (approx. 2 droppers full) per day, or as directed by

product.title: Niacin - 90 tablets
product.body_html:
What is niacin?
Niacin belongs to the group of water-soluble B vitamins. The term niacin does not basically refer to a single vitamin, but stands for nicotinic acid and nicotinamide as well as their compounds. In contrast to many other vitamins, the human body also produces niacin itself: in the liver from the amino acid tryptophan. As a component of important coenzymes, niacin is involved in many reactions in all cells of the body. These include, for example, processes of cell division, the formation and breakdown of carbohydrates, amino acids and fatty acids, and the immune response. Niacin also promotes energy metabolism, contributes to mental resilience, brain and nerve functions, is involved in learning and helps to nourish the skin from the inside out.

Vitamin B3 in the diet
Vitamin B3 is found in meat, fish, whole grains, nuts, seeds, vegetables and potatoes.

Vitamin B3 as a tablet
Niacin from NaturesPlus contains 90 tablets.

That is important
Since niacin stimulates blood circulation, it can temporarily cause a severe but harmless red discoloration of the skin (a so-called flush). Alternatively, niacinamide can be used, which does not trigger this flush.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Glucosamine/Chondroitin Rx-Joint® - 60 tablets
product.body_html:
Support of bones and joints
Rx-Joint® with Vitamin C and Manganese is specially formulated to support bones and joints. Vitamin C is important for the formation of collagen, which contributes to the normal function of cartilage. Manganese is good for the formation of cartilage in the joints and supports the maintenance of connective tissue. The product also contains glucosamine and chondroitin.

With glucosamine and chondroitin
Glucosamine and chondroitin are substances that occur naturally in our body. Cartilage and synovial fluid in particular contain large amounts of these building materials. Under normal circumstances, the body can synthesize these substances on its own. To increase the absorption of these substances, a supplement can have a supportive effect.

Rx-Joint® Tablets
Rx-Joint® provides 500 mg of glucosamine and 500 mg of chondroitin in sulfate form per tablet. Each pack contains 60 extended-release tablets, which gradually releases the substances in the body.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.
